- llms.txt: https://ishob.com/llms.txt
- MCP server: https://api.ishob.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP); server card: https://ishob.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- Official MCP Registry: com.ishob/archive
- Docs per tool: https://ishob.com/tools
